# `add_docket_to_tag`

**Add Docket to Tag**

- **Source:** `courtlistener/mcp/tools/add_docket_to_tag_tool.py`
- **Estimated definition size:** ~265 tokens (description ~81, input schema ~95; cl100k_base)
- **Parameters:** 2 (2 required)
- **Raw input schema:** [`add_docket_to_tag.inputs.json`](./add_docket_to_tag.inputs.json)

## Description

Add a docket to one of the user's tags on CourtListener.

Does nothing if the docket is already in the tag; the result then has
`already_tagged` set. To start a new tag, use `create_tag` first.

Use `call_endpoint` with endpoint_id "docket-tags" to see which
dockets are in a tag (filter by `tag`).
